provenance.method: logOdds = β_c × (C̄_H − C̄_R) + β_p × (P̄_H − P̄_R), with β_c = -0.0992 (Construc_Cost_Real) and β_p = 0.0143 (Zillow_Price_Real), slide 31. The indices are lagged 2 years, as the Controller's model uses them (slide 30: "2 years prior"): H is index years 2021-2023 (panel years 2023-2025) and R index years 2005-2023 (panel years 2007-2025). C̄_H = 115.267 and C̄_R = 101.747, means of the cost index (slide 16, Blended Construction Cost Index (inflation-adjusted, 2016 = 100), read from the chart); P̄_H = 89.5, the 2021-2023 mean, and P̄_R = (16 × 85.2 + 3 × 89.5) ÷ 19 = 85.8789, the year-weighted mean of the two period means (slide 15, 10-Neighborhood Average, Historical (inflation-adjusted, 2016 = 100), read from the chart; period means only). logOdds = -0.0992 × (115.267 − 101.747) + 0.0143 × (89.5 − 85.8789) = -1.28933. The index values are chart-read, approximate. Reported, never applied: the Controller's model is annual, on a lot producing housing; ours is monthly, on a project's first filing; the two shifts are comparable only as odds ratios.
